beats.visual_action: Escalating compute tiles fill a silicon field.
A fixed power envelope frames an expanding workload.
Wafer-to-product framing connects the constraint to TSMC.
Three channels assemble under a surrounding gate.
Current pulses trace the gated channels.
Production status appears beside the active structure.
Normalize the N2 power baseline to 100.
A14 bar moves to 75; a comparison band opens.
The band extends to 70; both range endpoints are labeled.
Reclaimed power space becomes a highlighted design envelope.
Cyan signal routes illuminate over the silicon plane.
Ruby rails move below the signal plane; vias connect them.

beats.message: A12. Free routing. Reduce voltage drop.
beats.visual_action: Front routing and backside power get separate annotated paths.

beats.message: Compute is only half the story.
beats.visual_action: Compute dies arrive on the package substrate.
HBM stacks move inward and descend toward the compute dies.
Interconnect pulses cross the integrated package.
Paths branch into training, inference and HPC applications.
A14 and A13 footprints compare at the correct area ratio.
Design blocks map between the two footprints.
The saved perimeter is highlighted; planned 2029 remains visible.

beats.message: What could lower power be worth?
beats.visual_action: The diagram becomes an electricity calculation.
Three assumptions connect into an equation.
The baseline resolves and the savings range separates.
Potential annual chip-energy savings count into a range.

beats.message: Measure the system. Validate the business case.
beats.visual_action: The assumptions remain attached to the result and exclusions appear.
Roadmap begins with the production milestone.
The roadmap advances to the efficiency platform.
Power delivery and density branches complete the roadmap.
A bold red end frame resolves around the TSMC name.
The final action replaces the promise and points to the official portfolio.
